observation.visible_scene: Interior of a curved, padded cabin (fisheye/wide-angle view) with ceiling light panels and a bundled rope/net fixed to the left wall. About a dozen people in dark flight suits (several with flag patches) occupy the space; some are seated or crouched on the floor in the mid-background, one holds a phone up, and a person sits at the far-right edge holding a white-and-red megaphone that becomes visible partway through. The camera viewpoint is stable: background panels, lights and the rope bundle keep the same positions across all frames, so observed motion is the people's, not the camera's.
visible_changes: The reddish-haired woman in the right foreground begins in a horizontal, feet-off-the-floor floating pose with arms extended forward, then lowers until her feet contact the floor, crouches, bends forward, and by the end stands with her back to the camera and her left arm stretched out to touch the left wall.

The blonde woman behind her likewise starts suspended horizontally with one arm extended, descends to a standing/crouched position on the floor, and later stands upright with an arm reaching toward the right wall panel.

The man on the right wall cycles from a tucked floating posture near the wall, to an upright crouch with hands near the wall, and back to a horizontal floating pose with legs drawn in by the final frames.
Several people in the central cluster remain seated/crouched on the floor throughout, with only small posture shifts; the man holding the phone keeps it raised and roughly stationary.
The far-right seated observer stays seated; a white cone-shaped megaphone with a red top appears in their hands from around the middle of the clip onward.
Overall, multiple individuals alternately drift away from the floor into floating poses and settle back down to crouch or stand, changing body orientation from horizontal to vertical and vice versa.
outside_clip_unknowns: The cause of the floating/grounding transitions (e.g., an aircraft maneuver or push-off) is not shown; the clip is a cropped excerpt and motion may have begun before frame 1 and continue after the last frame.
What the people do after the final frame (whether they float again or remain standing) is not visible.
uncertain_details: Camera motion is minimal/none given fixed background features, but slight drift cannot be fully excluded.
Individual identities and exact hand-held objects (phone vs. other device) are not certain.
Whether the foreground woman's left-arm extension is a deliberate wall touch or a balance pose is inferred from posture only.
